name: github-repository-search
title: GitHub Repository Search
description: Search repositories on GitHub and open previously visited ones faster.
author: thomas

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Repositories
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Search repositories on GitHub and open previously visited ones faster.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with GitHub OAuth. Set a token for GitHub Enterprise or to use a PAT instead.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: GitHub Base URL
preferences.description: Optional Base URL for GitHub Enterprise (e.g. https://github.acme-inc.com/api/v3). Defaults to the public GitHub.

preferences.name: users
preferences.title: Users / Organizations to search in
preferences.description: Limit the search to a comma-separated list of users or organizations, e.g. 'mheidinger, raycast'. Tip: Use '@me' to search only your own repositories.

preferences.name: includeForks
preferences.label: Include Forks
preferences.description: Include forked repositories in search results.

preferences.name: additionalFilters
preferences.title: Additional Filters
preferences.description: Additional filters to limit the repositories search, e.g. 'language:typescript'. See https://ray.so/0XgqB6q for all filters.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
